memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly. So on that day Moses swore to me, 'The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.'" - Josh 14:8-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Twice in these two verses the same phrase rings out: Caleb "followed the Lord wholeheartedly." It is the defining description of his life, spoken once by Caleb and once repeated in God's promise through Moses. While the other spies made the people's hearts melt with fear, Caleb followed God with his whole heart — not half-heartedly, not with one eye on the giants, but fully.

That word "wholeheartedly" is worth sitting with. So much of our following God is partial. We trust Him in some areas and hold others back; we obey when it is easy and hesitate when it costs. Caleb stands out precisely because he held nothing back. His whole heart was in it. And God noticed. The promise of inheritance was tied directly to that wholehearted devotion.

We cannot earn God's love by our devotion — salvation is always by grace. But wholehearted following is still God's call on every believer's life, and He delights to honour it. Jesus said the greatest commandment is to love the Lord with all our heart, soul, mind, and strength (Mark 12:30). Caleb lived that out long before it was spoken as the great command. And the good news is that Christ, who followed the Father with a perfect whole heart, now lives in us by His Spirit, growing in us the wholehearted love we could never produce alone.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- In what areas are you following God only half-heartedly?
- What would it look like to follow the Lord "wholeheartedly" this week?
- How does Christ's own wholehearted obedience encourage and empower you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, so much of my following You is divided and partial. Give me a whole heart for You, and by Your Spirit grow in me the wholehearted love that Caleb showed. Amen.
